# Opal Pettigrew

[Regent’s Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy)

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P56](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0056)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Opal Pettigrew is described as the most beautiful girl at the [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy), possessing a truly striking appearance. She has radiant skin, a good complexion, and big, vivid blue eyes, along with a long blonde plait. Her physical figure is characterized as full, eye-catching, and vigorous.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Regent’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Opal Pettigrew possesses a generally sunny and pleasant disposition, though she is prone to hysteria and sentimentality. She is deeply preoccupied with male attention and beaus, openly fixating on suitors, boys, and the compliments she receives. Her goals center on romance; she intends to secure a boyfriend at age fifteen, keep numerous suitors enthralled once she reaches adulthood, and enjoy a lively time before settling down, planning to teach for only two years after qualifying before marrying. Additionally, she harbor specific fears, including a deadly terror of plump green caterpillars and a dread of lying flat while pretending to be deceased on a floating vessel.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Nell Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P6](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), +4 more_

## History

Opal Pettigrew grew up with a large number of older sisters who were quickly married off, a process she once witnessed while hiding inside a hallway pantry during her sister Tabitha's marriage proposal. As a young girl, Opal expressed a desire to have dozens of suitors when she grew up, and she cured her warts using an enchanted stone from old [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md). She later attended school and Regent's alongside [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md). Eventually, Opal received a marriage proposal from Nelson Atkins, but upon returning home, she wrote him a blistering rejection.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Isolde Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P17](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0017), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P56](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0056), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P58](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0058), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)_
